What does our digital future look, feel, and dream like? Join us for BLUR: Dreaming in Data, an immersive exhibition celebrating a new international partnership between @NieuweInstituut , @LimboMuseum, and @lumako.xyz This is the start of something big: a dedicated platform for the digital arts in Ghana. We’re kicking it off by bringing together six groundbreaking artists—three from Ghana and three from the Nieuwe Instituut’s -1 Residency—to explore the new paradigms shaping our world. Come for the boundary-pushing art, stay for the conversation and celebration. We invite you to be part of this future. Supported by the Dutch Embassy. 🗓️ DATE: NOV 1st ⏰ TIME: 12 PM - 8 PM 📍 LOCATION: TREEHOUSE, OSU, ACCRA 🎟️ ENTRY: 250 GHS (Includes all-day exhibition access, after party + 1 free drink) #digitalarts #nieweinstituut #limbomuseum #lumako #immersiveexperience

GET READY FOR THE ULTIMATE FASHION EXPERIENCE! Mark your calendars for January 4th, 2025, as the @treehousegh transforms into a vibrant hub of African heritage, vintage glamour, and sustainable style! Join us for the MAIDEN EDITION of the @vintageupghanafestival (VUG), featuring: 30+ global and local vintage vendors showcasing rare treasures. * Electrifying fashion shows that blend tradition with modern flair! The ultimate Drip Contest: come dressed to impress! dj Soul-stirring music to keep you grooving all day! * Live Upcycling Workshops: witness creativity in action with Africa’s most innovative designers! Get hands-on experience and learn from the masters as they transform discarded materials into stunning, eco-friendly pieces. Don’t miss this opportunity to network, learn, and be inspired! It’s free!!! Just get your Drip on #VintageUpGhana #VUGFest2025 #SustainableFashion #AfricanHeritage #FashionFestival #TreeHouseAccra #UpcyclingWorkshops #EcoFriendlyFashion Are you coming?
